testing_progress.highlight: pq-devnet-0 stalled: clients generating XMSS keys at different times; some waited until last slot, requiring up to 2h for key gen under 12s constraint
55-slot reorg caused by late attestations; Prysm rejected reorgs >32 slots; max reorg depth flag set to unlimited, chain slowly recovering
Prysm and Grandine flagged as blockers; Ethlambda had no key-gen issues (cached quickly); Lighthouse pre-generated 256 epochs in advance

leanvm_updates.highlight: LeanVM 0.17 released: FFI (not sidecar), 15% faster recursion, single binary with runtime CPU dispatch (AVX2/AVX512/GFNI), breaking change requiring coordinated update
Trade-off available: 7.5% faster proving at cost of 15% larger proof size (~200–300 KB today); consensus not to optimize STARK until setup is finalized

staking_contract.highlight: Staking contract moved to sys-asm repo (PR open); XMSS verifier uses EVM bytecode via a dedicated opcode, living in a separate contract via static call
Concern raised: validators reusing BLS mnemonic for PQ keys could be problematic if mnemonic is later destroyed; ERC should allow independent mnemonic

erc_key_derivation.highlight: ERC PR open (ethereum/ERCs#2214): specifies derivation from mnemonic → seed → XMSS and VRF keys; ERC-2335 (JSON keystore format) also in progress

aggregator_role.highlight: Proposal to define a separate aggregator role (opt-in, balance-weighted selection) discussed; Potuz: adds enough complexity to warrant moving to PQ-DC instead
Decision: defer aggregator role; avoid adding it to first PQ fork if possible; revisit when quick slots or faster finality are needed

networking.highlight: Kamil: Lighthouse branch implements fast-proof broadcast (Merkle-root signed chunks); simulations show 1.7 duplicate messages vs ~7 with gossipsub at 4K peers/32K validators
Csaba: Prysm Go zcast implementation targeting end-of-day/tomorrow; compatible with Silver (vlad) implementation; single-client Kurtosis testing recommended before multi-client devnet
Need for a shared P2P spec (message signing, chunking details) flagged; Kamil and Csaba to align on wire protocol before cross-client testing

p2p_timing_measurements.highlight: Mark: initial devnet-0 timing data showed attestations arriving up to 9s; Lighthouse fixes (correct CPU target, per-attestation sending) resolved the worst of it; committee proving starts at 4.5s, within 6s window
Proposer/aggregator prover contention identified: if proposing slot S+2 and aggregating S+1, tasks compete for prover; Potuz: just drop the aggregate in that case

organizational.highlight: Call cadence reduced: tomorrow's call canceled; keeping Friday call; plan to reduce to 1–2 per week going forward
pq-devnet-1 notes page published; next devnet will NOT include fork transition or system contract testing — focus remains on timing/aggregation
